comment: Wizard-mode Samurai on the Castle level. A controlled teleport lands west of the raised drawbridge, and a wand of cold bridges its moat span with ice (DRAWBRIDGE_UP over DB_ICE). The hero walks onto the span, where slippery_ice_fumbling() reads is_ice(), drops a tripe ration, creates a tame kitten, and steps off west; the kitten's next move goes to the food on the span through mfndpos(), which admits a raised span that is not over moat or lava.
